description: This file defines a class HeliconeLogger that handles logging of events to Helicone, including mapping responses from Claude model, adding metadata from headers, and the main method for logging success responses.

classes.name: HeliconeLogger
classes.description: A class that manages logging of AI model interactions to Helicone, supporting multiple models and handling metadata, API requests, and response processing.

methods.name: claude_mapping(self, model, messages, response_obj)
methods.description: Converts a response object from Claude into a standardized format, including parsing tool calls and content.

methods.name: dict add_metadata_from_header(litellm_params: dict, metadata: dict)
methods.description: Extracts and adds specific headers prefixed with 'helicone_' from request headers into the metadata dictionary.

methods.name: log_success( self, model, messages, response_obj, start_time, end_time, print_verbose, kwargs )
methods.description: Main method to log a successful response to Helicone, including formatting requests and responses and handling special cases for Claude and embeddings.

ctags.signature: ( self, model, messages, response_obj, start_time, end_time, print_verbose, kwargs )
